features.title: Energy-to-metal converters (metal makers)
features.evidence_runtime: src/world.rs:3100-3102 only pays metal_make/energy_make and (negative) upkeep; there is no conversion gadget model

features.title: Shield generators (repulsor)

features.title: Death explosions and wrecks/corpses
features.evidence_runtime: src/catalog.rs:788-815 and src/world.rs support death_explosion_*, corpse, reclaimable, corpse_metal
features.evidence_exporter: none of death_explosion_*, corpse*, reclaim_* are exported (explodeas names a weapon in gamedata; corpse metal is in the unit's featuredefs)
features.current_behavior: Units die silently and leave no reclaimable metal; chain explosions (e.g. fusion, nukes) and wreck economy are absent
features.suggested_fix: Resolve explodeas against gamedata and featuredefs.metal for corpse_metal

features.title: Cloaking (cancloak, initcloaked, cloakcost)
features.evidence_runtime: can_cloak exists only in src/catalog.rs/src/model.rs; no consumer in engine.rs/world.rs even though CAPABILITY_CLOAK is listed in IMPLEMENTED_CAPABILITIES
features.current_behavior: Cloakable units are permanently visible; the declared capability claims support that does not exist
features.suggested_fix: Either implement cloak visibility masks or remove CAPABILITY_CLOAK from IMPLEMENTED_CAPABILITIES and export required_capabilities so scenarios fail loudly
